methodology_note: cargo/rustc does NOT track ordered.ld as a build input. Swapping ordered.ld alone never triggers a relink - the cached .so is silently reused (every variant measured byte-identical). A source file MUST be touched before each rebuild to force the linker to re-run with the new script. All step2 measures below are forced relinks of the IDENTICAL window-complete source (same input objects) so the ONLY variable is the linker-script .text/.rodata/.data.rel.ro ordering.
